$comment: Canonical skill slots. 'owner_axis' names the axis whose selected fragment supplies the body. 'composite' slots additionally append sections contributed by other axes. 'emit_as' is declared per-fragment, not here — see fragment.json.

backend-service.$comment: The framework owns the module/controller/service shape; the ORM supplies the data-access blocks via the #provider and #crud_base anchors. Keeping those in the ORM fragment is what lets a future orm/prisma drop in without forking the NestJS body.
